34086-the-ifs-of-history.description: A book by Joseph Edgar Chamberlin. Mithra instead of Jesus! The western world Zoroastrian, not Christian! The Persian Redeemer, always called the Light of the World in their scriptures; the helper of Ahura-Mazda, the Almighty, in his warfare with Ahriman, or Satan; the intercessor for men with the Creator; the Saviour of humanity; he, Mithra, might have been the central person of the dominant religion of Europe and modern times, but for certain developments in Athenian politics in the years between 490 and 480 B.

arxiv-1907-10210.title: A CNN-based tool for automatic tongue contour tracking in ultrasound images
arxiv-1907-10210.description: Abstract For speech research, ultrasound tongue imaging provides a non-invasive means for visualizing tongue position and movement during articulation. Extracting tongue contours from ultrasound images is a basic step in analyzing ultrasound data but this task often requires non-trivial manual annotation.

arxiv-2106-13022.title: Two New Kinds of Interference Alignment Schemes for Cellular K K -user MIMO Downlink Networks
arxiv-2106-13022.creator: Jingfu Li, Wenjiang Feng, F. Richard Yu, Weiheng Jiang
arxiv-2106-13022.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Jingfu Li, Wenjiang Feng, F. Richard Yu, Weiheng Jiang. It is known that interference alignment (IA) plays an important role in improving the degree of freedom (DoF) of multi-input and multi-output (MIMO) systems. However, most of the traditional IA schemes suffer from the high computational complexity and require the global and instantaneous channel state information (CSI), both of which make them difficult to be extended to cellular MIMO systems.

arxiv-2203-16957.title: Topological obstructions to the diagonalisation of pseudodifferential systems
arxiv-2203-16957.creator: Matteo Capoferri, Grigori Rozenblum, Nikolai Saveliev, Dmitri Vassiliev
arxiv-2203-16957.description: Abstract Given a matrix pseudodifferential operator on a smooth manifold, one may be interested in diagonalising it by choosing eigenvectors of its principal symbol in a smooth manner. We show that diagonalisation is not always possible, on the whole cotangent bundle or even in a single fibre.

arxiv-2407-20617.title: Timelike meson form-factors beyond the elastic region from lattice QCD
arxiv-2407-20617.creator: Felipe G. Ortega-Gama, Jozef J. Dudek, Robert G. Edwards, for the Hadron Spectrum Collaboration
arxiv-2407-20617.description: Abstract We present a calculation of the vector-isovector timelike form-factors of the pion and the kaon using lattice quantum chromodynamics. We calculate two-point correlation functions with m π ∼ 280 m_{\pi}\sim 280 MeV , extracting both the finite-volume spectrum and matrix elements for these states created from the vacuum by a vector current.

arxiv-2412-15844.title: Efficient Curation of Invertebrate Image Datasets Using Feature Embeddings and Automatic Size Comparison Thanks: This work was funded by Research Council of Finland project 333497.
arxiv-2412-15844.creator: Mikko Impiö, Philipp M. Rehsen, Jenni Raitoharju
arxiv-2412-15844.description: Abstract The amount of image datasets collected for environmental monitoring purposes has increased in the past years as computer vision assisted methods have gained interest. Computer vision applications rely on high-quality datasets, making data curation important. However, data curation is often done ad-hoc and the methods used are rarely published.

arxiv-2501-15940.title: Equivalent Conditions for Domination of M ⁡ ( 2 , ℂ ) \mathrm{M}(2,{\mathbb{C}}) -sequences
arxiv-2501-15940.creator: Chang Sun and Zhenghe Zhang
arxiv-2501-15940.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Chang Sun and Zhenghe Zhang. It is well known that a SL ⁡ ( 2 , ℂ ) \mathrm{SL}(2,{\mathbb{C}}) -sequence is uniformly hyperbolic if and only it satisfies a uniform exponential growth condition. Similarly, for GL ⁡ ( 2 , ℂ ) \mathrm{GL}(2,{\mathbb{C}}) -sequences whose determinants are uniformly bounded away from zero, it has dominated splitting if and only if it satisfies a uniform exponential gap condition between the two singular values.

arxiv-2501-17818.title: Gleaning gravitational amplitudes – a double copy for canceling dilatons
arxiv-2501-17818.creator: Henrik Johansson, Ingrid A. Vazquez-Holm
arxiv-2501-17818.description: Abstract Scattering amplitudes in general relativity can be conveniently computed using the double copy, which relates them to Yang-Mills amplitudes. However, unwanted dilatons are sourced by massive scalar matter, which must be removed from the double copy in order to match the long range gravitational interactions.

pmc-12691777.creator: Lucia Sportiello, Maria Concetta Tenuta, Roberta Tolve, Fabio Favati, Gabriele Quarati, Giovanna Ferrentino

pmc-13204495.title: Interaction of Human Lymphocyte Scavenger Receptors CD5 and CD6 with Toxins from Naja haje, Androctonus australis and Apis mellifera Venoms
pmc-13204495.creator: Dalila Khemili, Laura Carrillo-Serradell, Violeta Planells-Romeo, Lucía Aragón-Serrano, Selma Djilani, Djelila Hammoudi-Triki, Khedidja Zerouti, Abdenacer Mouffok, Francisco Lozano, María Velasco-de-Andrés

pmc-13352837.title: Regression-based model for predicting preterm birth using vaginal lactobacilli and routine clinical data
pmc-13352837.creator: Lihua Kang, Yuan Su, Shu Li, Tao Zhang, Shuang Li, Chunli Li, Wei Cheng
pmc-13352837.description: BackgroundPreterm birth (PTB) is a leading cause of neonatal morbidity and mortality. Although increasing evidence links vaginal microbiota to preterm birth, clinically practical models integrating microbial and clinical indicators are lacking. We aimed to develop a model that combines vaginal microbiota with routine clinical data for prenatal PTB risk assessment.

pmc-13362100.title: Transcriptomic characterization of key psoriasis-associated genes based on single-cell RNA-seq and machine learning
pmc-13362100.creator: Weixiang Wang, Qiang Zhang, Suting Xu, Zhengrui Li, Zhengrui Li, Zhengrui Li, Zhengrui Li, Zhengrui Li
pmc-13362100.description: BackgroundPsoriasis is a multifaceted skin and systemic disorder driven by a complex interplay of genetic, immunological, and environmental factors. Genetic predisposition plays a pivotal role, with the IL-17/IL-23 immune axis recognized as a central pathogenic pathway. Ongoing research, however, continues to uncover additional critical drivers, cytokines, intracellular signaling networks, and potential therapeutic targets.

pmc-13581354.title: Trends in Intrauterine Device Use Before and After National Eligibility Guideline Changes
pmc-13581354.creator: Kandice A. Kapinos, Gabriela Alvarado, Kortney Floyd James
pmc-13581354.description: Updates to national clinical guidelines expanding intrauterine device (IUD) eligibility to nulliparous women were associated with increased IUD use, whereas use among parous women plateaued after 2014. Long-acting reversible contraceptives, which include intrauterine devices (IUDs) and etonogestrel implants, are among the most effective nonpermanent contraceptive methods, with failure rates of 0.8% and 0.05%, respectively.

pmc-13611758.title: Chemical Regimes and PMF-Resolved Sources Linked to Acute PM10 Ecotoxicity in Luanda, Angola
pmc-13611758.creator: Alan Victor da Silva, Estela D. Vicente, Ana M. Sánchez de la Campa, Yago Cipoli, Diogo N. Cardoso, Susana Loureiro, Anabela Leitão, Manuel Feliciano, Célia Alves
